'''''Echinops ritro''''', the '''southern globe thistle''', is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Asteraceae]], [[native plant|native]] to southern and eastern Europe, from Spain east to Turkey, Ukraine, and Belarus, and western and central Asia east to Mongolia.<ref name="POWO"/><ref>{{cite web | title=Flora Italiana | website=Echinops ritro [Cardo pallottola meridionale] | url=http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=echinops+ritro | language=it | access-date=2025-09-04}}</ref> The species is also sparingly [[naturalisation (biology)|naturalised]] in scattered locations within [[North America]].<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=200023868 Flora of North America, ''Echinops ritro'' Linnaeus]</ref><ref>[http://bonap.net/MapGallery/County/Echinops%20ritro.png Biota of North America Program, 2014 county distribution map]</ref>

==Description==
It is a compact, bushy [[herbaceous plant|herbaceous]] [[perennial plant|perennial]] [[thistle]], growing to {{convert|60|cm|0|abbr=on}} tall, with broad prickly leaves and bearing globes of steel-blue flowers {{convert|2.5-4.5|cm||1|abbr=on}} in diameter, in late summer.<ref name=RHSAZ>{{cite book|title=RHS A-Z encyclopedia of garden plants|year=2008|publisher=Dorling Kindersley|location=United Kingdom|isbn=978-1405332965|pages=1136}}</ref>

==Taxonomy==
Five [[subspecies]] are accepted by the [[Plants of the World Online]] database:<ref name="POWO"/>
*''Echinops ritro'' subsp. ''meyeri'' <small>(DC.) Kožuharov</small>
*[[Echinops ritro subsp. ritro|''Echinops ritro'' subsp. ''ritro'']]
*[[Echinops ritro subsp. ruthenicus|''Echinops ritro'' subsp. ''ruthenicus'']] <small>(M.Bieb.) Nyman</small>
*''Echinops ritro'' subsp. ''sartorianus'' <small>(Boiss. & Heldr.) Kožuharov</small>
*''Echinops ritro'' subsp. ''thracicus'' <small>(Velen.) Kožuharov</small>
Additionally, one [[variety (botany)|variety]] is accepted, but without specification as to which subspecies it belongs to:<ref name="POWO"/>
*''Echinops ritro'' var. ''elbursensis'' (Rech.f.) Parsa

==Cultivation==
''Echinops ritro''<ref>{{cite web|title=RHS Plant Selector - ''Echinops ritro''|url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/105703/Echinops-ritro-L/Details | accessdate = 5 June 2020}}</ref> and the subspecies ''E. ritro'' subsp. ''ruthenicus''<ref>{{cite web|title=RHS Plant Selector - ''Echinops ritro'' subsp. ''ruthenicus'' |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/98351/Echinops-ritro-subsp-ruthenicus/Details | accessdate = 5 June 2020}}</ref> have gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].

Plants previously reported as naturalised in Great Britain are mostly or all the related species ''[[Echinops bannaticus]]''.<ref>{{cite web | title=Blue Globe-thistle ''Echinops bannaticus'' Rochel ex Schrad. | website=PlantAtlas | url=https://plantatlas2020.org/atlas/2cd4p9h.kcm | access-date=2025-09-05}}</ref>
